title: Width bound for a first-layer function
statement: Let $C$ be a depth circuit on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $i$ index one of its first-layer gates. If the first-layer gates are AND gates, the function computed by gate $i$ has a CNF representation of width at most the width of $C$; if they are OR gates, it has a DNF representation of width at most the width of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A depth circuit C on the n-dimensional sign cube
An index i of a first-layer gate
